name: SSHOW
description:
SSHOW is a design tool where one canvas holds your layout, its motion, and the
presentation you give from it.

Connect this server and Claude works inside the project you already have open in
a SSHOW editor — on the web, in the desktop app, or on a tablet. It reads the
scene tree and object detail, adds or changes text, shapes, images and
keyframes, moves your view to the scene it is working on, and takes a screenshot
to check its own work by sight.

Everything lands in the project on your screen, so you watch each change as it
happens. A batch of edits arrives as a single undo step, and Claude can undo or
redo it for you. Nothing runs when you have no editor open: the server reaches
only the sessions you have open right now, never your stored files.

What you need: a free SSHOW account and a project open at s.show or in the SSHOW
desktop app. You sign in once when you connect, and you can end the connection
at any time from your SSHOW profile.

Try: "Summarise the structure of the project I have open." — "Add a title that
reads Quarterly Review and fade it in." — "Take a screenshot and tell me what to
fix." — "Undo that."

_published_faq.name: How do I add SSHOW to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SSHOW to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://s.show/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SSHOW MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SSHOW provides these MCP tools: apply_actions, get_guide, get_object, get_project_overview, get_scene, get_screenshot, list_projects, redo, select_objects, set_active_scene, and undo.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SSHOW?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SSHOW in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.
SSHOW requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SSHOW is developed by SSHOW. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
